task.title: Fix preview observer dashboard workspace stream enable failure

events.content: Make dashboard login stream-enable non-blocking and harden preview host forwarding: Make dashboard login stream-enable non-blocking and harden preview host forwarding

raw.question: Make dashboard login stream-enable non-blocking and harden preview host forwarding
raw.chosen: Make dashboard login stream-enable non-blocking and harden preview host forwarding
raw.reasoning: Preview observer traffic can lose original host context through edge/page hops, and stream toggle support may differ across backend versions; login should remain functional while preserving correct PR API routing.

retrospective.summary: Fixed preview observer login failures by forwarding a dedicated observer-host header from observer-router, prioritizing that header in dashboard relay URL resolution, and making workspace stream enablement best-effort during login.
